response.original_title: TW-LOG ep. JIHYO pt. 2 (Twice 6th World Tour 'This Is For')
response.overview: Twice's leader, Jihyo, documents the European leg of their record breaking 6th World Tour, "This Is For." In her debut documentary feature, she explores behind the scenes of these concerts, as well as what makes the beautiful cities they visit unique.
response.title: TW-LOG ep. JIHYO pt. 2 (Twice 6th World Tour 'This Is For')
